def false_match_guard_skips_case_body(flow, manager, value):
    metadata = flow.metadata
    with manager:
        match value:
            case _ if False:

        metadata = {}
    return metadata["vm_run_id"]


def true_exhaustive_match_guard_skips_later_cases(flow, manager, value):
    metadata = flow.metadata
    with manager:
        match value:
            case _ if True:
                pass
            case _:
                operation()
        metadata = {}
    return metadata["firewall_name"]
